summary: ODDITY Tech filed a Form 6-K furnishing its second-quarter 2026 earnings press release, headlined by capital-return actions and an operating update. The company repurchased ~5.6 million Class A ordinary shares for ~$80 million in Q2 2026 under a $200 million buyback plan authorized March 2026, and retired $50 million principal of zero-coupon 2030 exchangeable notes. Year-to-date repurchases total ~11.7 million shares for ~$163 million, cutting shares outstanding ~20%; ~$87 million remains authorized. Q2 net revenue was $181 million, down ~25% year-over-year; cash and investments were $561 million. Watch buyback execution pace and IL MAKIAGE advertising-algorithm normalization.
